title: elymus sajanensis subsp. coeruleus
intro: Elymus sajanensis subsp. coeruleus, commonly known as Blue Sajan Wildrye, is a type of grass that belongs to the family Poaceae. This plant is traditionally used for its medicinal properties, which include providing relief from respiratory issues such as bronchitis and coughs due to its anti-inflammatory and expectorant properties. The bioactive constituents of Blue Sajan Wildrye include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins, which contribute to its therapeutic actions, including anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and immunomodulatory effects. The health benefits of Elymus sajanensis subsp. coeruleus include reducing inflammation, improving respiratory health, and potentially lowering blood pressure.
